context:
YOUR WORD (page save 00:09 CST Nov 15): "2", note: "B or A are good since botj avoid repeat run, ask consultant". Not taken as option 2: your word names two options (the page lists the Retire-line choice as 2/B and the shard-tree skip as 1/A) and says to ask the consultant, so triage is asking it. Option 2 widens a shared tool and goes against your ruling, so it is not taken on an unclear word. The item stays open, the lane waits, and nothing is built.
Goal: CI proves hooks/test_guard.py once per tree, with no repeat run and no weaker proof (your 20:17 CST Nov 14 goal).
Problem (rule): the lane's first fix would read the checks-guard shard jobs through `needs`. That accepts weaker evidence than main does today, so it widens what the debt check accepts, and only you can allow that.
Based on (measured): (1) when scope flag checks_guard is false, every shard step is skipped but the job result is still success, so a debt close would pass with no test run; (2) on a PR event the shards check out the merge commit, while the debt step runs $HEAD_SHA, a different tree; (3) job `checks` would wait about 16 min for the shards, against about 15 min today. (The lane's read of the workflow; triage read no workflow code.)
Based on (measured): the duplicate runs only on a PR that closes a debt whose Retire line names hooks/test_guard.py: 11 of 151 debts. Run 43678092611 closed none, so 0 extra min. Extra minutes per affected PR are unmeasured; the only figure is a pre-split workflow comment (median 21.1 min).
Departs from: main runs the whole Retire-named suite on the PR head inside `checks`; the debt step would skip that run when the shards ran on the same tree.
Meanwhile: the lane builds nothing and waits. Triage found no past owner ruling on this (searched the rulings for debt-close-runs-retire, Retire line, checks_guard; r2 and r15 name the decision only for the PR template, keep-merge-commit-skips-debt rewrites one debt's Retire line).

lastAnswer.note: consultant's pick, not typed by you: option 1 (skip only when the shards ran on this tree), asked by your own words "ask consultant"; ruling own-852-1; reopens if you say otherwise

options.gain: No repeat run and no weaker proof.
options.label: Skip the debt step's run only when the shards ran on this tree: read the shard result and the scope flag; run the suite as now when the flag is false or the tree differs
options.lose: A more complex step; `checks` waits for the shards on PRs that close such a debt.

options.label: Make the Retire line name the shard
options.lose: A new Retire-line form, a change to decision debt-close-runs-retire, and the same weaker-proof gaps. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.label: Leave it as it is
options.lose: A repeat run, of unmeasured length, on each affected PR.

short: Debt step and guard shards: skip the repeat run safely, or not?
title: CI runs hooks/test_guard.py twice on a PR that closes a debt naming it. Skip the repeat only when the shards ran this tree (1), name the shard in the Retire line (2), or leave it (3)?
why: Option 2 and the plain `needs` fix would let the debt check pass on weaker proof, which only you can allow.
